notes.title: Ensora - Update v1.0.6.0
notes.content:
[h3]Whats new in update v1.0.6.0?[/h3]


[h2]Added a new type of enemy units - Sand Parasites[/h2]

This is a wild creature that has inhabited the planet since ancient times. It feeds on underground mineral and human flesh, often preying on unprepared travelers in the deserts of Ensora.
Sand parasites always move in groups, attack from under the sand, and they are able to call their relatives for help.

To protect against these creatures, the inhabitants of Ensora use special radio stations that scare away parasites with their high signal. Without stations, any desert camp is in danger.
It is also known that this creature is very afraid of loud noise.

The new unit belongs to the "Against All" faction, but does not fight the infected, since it cannot feed on poisoned flesh.

Killing sand parasites increases your reputation. In the entrails of these creatures, you can find a mineral, and sometimes other useful items that the parasite managed to swallow.


[h2]Other changes[/h2]

- Fixed a bug where enemy units would shoot through walls in some situations.
- Reduced the block time for actions when a player takes damage.
- Fixed a few other minor bugs.

notes.title: Ensora - Update 1.0.5.0
notes.content:
[b]Whats new in Update 1.0.5.0?[/b]

[h2]Added full Gamepad support, which includes[/h2]
- Help in aiming at enemies and destructible objects (can be disabled);
- The vibration function, which is activated when the player takes damage, shoots and in some other situations (can also be disabled);
- Force-adjustable bike throttle and brake levels;
- Menu for reassigning Gamepad buttons.

[h2]Added game control hints[/h2]
Now some hotkeys or gamepad buttons are displayed on the screen in various game situations.

[h2]Other changes[/h2]
Improved bike behavior and fixed a bug where the player could not sit on the bike due to the parking angle being too high.

The items "Raider's Bracelet" and "Experimental Vaccine" no longer appear for sale in the digital market.

Slightly increased the brightness of the illumination of objects and enemy units in tactical scanner mode.

Fixed some minor bugs.
